datasheet_identity.title: SS52C THRU SS520C Surface Mount Schottky Barrier Rectifier

extraction_notes: Forward and reverse characteristic points were digitized from the usable typical curves in Fig. 3 and Fig. 4; the SS510C curve is part of the grouped SS58C-SS510C or SS58C-SS520C family curve.
The electrical-characteristics table groups SS58C and SS510C at VF = 0.85 V and groups SS58C-SS520C at CJ = 450 pF; values were assigned to SS510C from those grouped columns.
Reverse recovery time is not published in the supplied datasheet.
The reverse-current row at TA = 100 degC is 10 mA and was not used as the 25 degC reverse-current input.
Rated reverse voltage is 100 V and average forward rectified current is 5.0 A from the absolute maximum ratings.
No zener breakdown voltage or breakdown-current specification is published.
